sample_unit: synthetic virtual patients (25 per trial across 3 breast cancer trials)
unlisted_practices: Compressing patient records into condensed natural-language 'patient sentences' for LLM trial eligibility screening, comparing concordance with full-record decisions and token cost

screen.reason: The study evaluates a novel framework/method (Patient2Sentence) for semantic compression of patient records to facilitate trial eligibility matching using synthetic patient records, evaluating concordance and token efficiency rather than testing a specific clinical deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
